title: My Business Center
description: The corporate management and business operations environment.
connections: Connect to the corporate organization database, financial ledger, HR records, CRM, document storage, approval engine, calendar, notification service, and Global Reporting & Analytics. Financial records must support reporting periods, currency, account classification, source documents, approvals, and audit trails. IntelliSync may transfer authorized financial and business records between approved connected systems. It must never silently overwrite financial records or treat an unverified import as an approved transaction.

title: My Workspace
description: Each employee's personal work environment.
connections: Connect to the employee directory, Global ID Center, IAM, New Active Directory, IntelliBase, IntelliDrive, calendar, task management, notifications, and workflow services. Employees may edit only their authorized profile fields. Sensitive information must be protected independently from ordinary profile information. IntelliSync handles authorized profile, employment, and directory synchronization. It must preserve the authoritative source for each field.

title: Global ID Center
description: Central management of platform-wide identifiers and identity relationships.
connections: Connect to IAM, New Active Directory, My Workspace, IntelliStaff, Tenant Desk, Connector Hub, and IntelliSync. Global IDs must be stable and unique. Do not generate duplicate global identities when external systems synchronize the same person. IntelliSync transfers identity references and authorized identity attributes. Global ID Center remains responsible for authoritative ID relationships.

title: Identity & Access Management
description: Platform-wide authentication, authorization, and security access administration.
connections: Connect to authentication services, Global ID Center, New Active Directory, Tenant Desk, applications, audit, approval workflows, and security monitoring. IAM is the final authority for platform authorization. Directory membership and synchronization do not independently grant application permissions. IntelliSync can synchronize approved identity and group information, but must never independently approve or grant access.

title: New Active Directory
description: Full directory administration, not merely an employee contact list.
connections: Connect to directory providers, Global ID Center, IAM, IntelliStaff, Connector Hub, IntelliSync, and security monitoring. Support real directory APIs and directory-specific permissions. Do not present an external directory as connected unless authentication and connectivity have actually been verified. IntelliSync handles approved directory synchronization and conflict resolution.

title: IntelliStack Configuration Center
description: Platform-wide system administration and operations.
connections: Connect to application configuration services, deployment infrastructure, platform monitoring, licensing, feature flags, backup services, IAM, and audit. Only authorized Global Administrators and scoped Platform Administrators may access the appropriate configuration functions. IntelliSync transfers configuration records only when explicitly approved. It must not copy production secrets or privileged credentials into other environments.

title: IntelliDesk Command Center
description: IT service management and technical service delivery.
connections: Connect to IntelliBase, Help Buddy, IAM, employee directory, asset records, notification services, calendar, workflow engine, and reporting. IntelliSync may synchronize authorized ticket records with external service-management platforms, maintaining ticket ownership, identifiers, and status mappings.

title: IntelliBase
description: Enterprise knowledge, documentation, training, and learning center.
connections: Connect to document storage, search, IntelliDesk, Help Buddy, Collaboration & Productivity, employee learning records, notification service, and audit. Star levels must be earned through completed training, assessments, and verified achievements—not simply by opening articles. IntelliSync transfers approved knowledge articles and metadata between authorized repositories, preserving version history and publication status.

title: IntelliStack Marketplace
description: Discover, evaluate, activate, and manage applications, modules, and extensions.
connections: Connect to licensing, billing, application registry services, IAM, Connector Hub, Configuration Center, and audit. Marketplace discovery and installation must not automatically authorize access to external data. IntelliSync can synchronize approved marketplace catalog metadata, subscriptions, and installation records. Installation itself remains a controlled application lifecycle operation.

title: Help Buddy
description: Personal AI assistant and work coordination workspace.
connections: Connect to AI Systems, IntelliBase, IntelliDesk, employee directory, calendar, task services, workflow engine, notifications, and approved application tools. Help Buddy must act only within the signed-in user's permissions. Studio changes require administrative permissions, versioning, testing, and audit. IntelliSync transfers approved task, note, and conversation metadata where configured. Private conversations must not be exported or replicated without explicit authorization and applicable retention controls.

title: Collaboration & Productivity
description: Internal communication and business productivity applications.
connections: Connect to file storage, messaging services, calendar, employee directory, IAM, notification service, workflow, and search. IntelliSync manages approved file, calendar, and communication metadata synchronization. Document versions, access permissions, and sharing restrictions must be preserved.

title: AI Systems & Intelligence
description: Central operating workspace for the platform's AI systems.
connections: Connect to AI Model & Provider Management, Help Buddy, IntelliBase, Configuration Center, IAM, workflow, audit, and approved application APIs. Maximus and Optimus must operate under scoped permissions. AI recommendations are not automatically approved business or security actions. IntelliSync transfers only authorized AI configuration metadata, approved knowledge indexes, and governed operational records. Never synchronize model secrets or private prompts indiscriminately.

title: IntelliStaff
description: administration.
connections: Connect to My Business Center, My Workspace, New Active Directory, Global ID Center, IAM, payroll integrations, calendar, IntelliBase, and reporting. IntelliSync transfers approved employee lifecycle records and recruiting data with privacy and field-level restrictions.

title: NOC — Network Operations Center
connections: Connect to monitoring systems, network management APIs, asset management, IntelliDesk, SOC, notifications, and Command & Control Center. IntelliSync transfers authorized inventory, monitoring events, and incident metadata. It must not expose network credentials or execute network changes merely because data was synchronized.

title: SOC — Security Operations Center
connections: Connect to IAM, security monitoring, endpoint protection, SIEM integrations, NOC, IntelliDesk, War Room, and audit. IntelliSync transfers approved security event data and case metadata with integrity, timestamps, evidence references, and classification labels.

title: Reports, Governance, Audit & Administration
description: Enterprise-wide compliance, governance, oversight, and audit administration.
connections: Connect to all platform audit streams, IAM, Configuration Center, Data Management Center, SOC, business records, and Global Reporting & Analytics. IntelliSync can transfer approved compliance evidence and report data. Audit records must remain tamper-evident and preserve provenance.

title: Tenant Desk
description: Manage companies, tenants, tenant administrators, and tenant-level operations.
connections: Connect to Global ID Center, IAM, Configuration Center, Marketplace, Connector Hub, IntelliSync, and reporting. Tenant isolation must be enforced in the database and server-side authorization layers. Tenant synchronization must never leak records across tenants.

title: Connector Hub
description: Discover, authorize, configure, and manage external application connections.
connections: Connect to provider APIs, secure secret storage, IAM, Tenant Desk, IntelliSync, and audit. Connector Hub establishes and manages connections. It does not own the data synchronization process. External credentials must be stored securely, never displayed in logs, and never passed into ordinary client-side code.

title: IntelliSync
description: The central data synchronization, exchange, mapping, validation, and transfer engine.
connections: Connect to Connector Hub, Global ID Center, IAM, New Active Directory, My Business Center, IntelliStaff, IntelliBase, Tenant Desk, Collaboration & Productivity, Data Management Center, and approved external providers. Mandatory IntelliSync transfer lifecycle 1. Identify the authorized source. 2. Identify the authorized destination. 3. Verify connector availability. 4. Verify tenant and user permissions. 5. Confirm data ownership. 6. Select permitted data fields. 7. Map source and destination fields. 8. Apply approved transformation rules. 9. Validate data. 10. Detect duplicates. 11. Preview proposed changes. 12. Obtain required approval. 13. Execute transfer. 14. Record transfer results. 15. Reconcile source and destination. 16. Preserve history and audit records. Required transfer safeguards No unauthorized cross-tenant transfer. No silent overwrite of authoritative records. No synchronization of passwords, tokens, private keys, or secrets. No implicit IAM permission grants. No unapproved financial transaction imports. No loss of source identifiers or timestamps. No deletion without an approved deletion policy. All transfers must be traceable and reversible where technically appropriate.

title: Automation Center
description: Create, schedule, manage, and monitor automated tasks.
connections: Connect to workflow engine, IntelliSync, Connector Hub, notification service, IAM, API & Developer Center, and audit. IntelliSync may move automation configuration and approved execution records between environments. It must not transfer production credentials or activate unapproved automations.

title: API & Developer Center
description: Developer tools, API management, application integration, and technical documentation.
connections: Connect to API gateway, IAM, Connector Hub, Configuration Center, developer documentation, and audit. IntelliSync can synchronize API metadata, webhook configuration references, and approved usage records. Secrets must never be transferred as ordinary data.

title: Data Management Center
description: Manage enterprise data quality, classification, ownership, retention, and lifecycle.
connections: Connect to IntelliSync, Connector Hub, storage, IAM, Global ID Center, audit, and reporting. IntelliSync executes approved transfers; Data Management Center governs data ownership, classification, quality, and permitted use.

title: Workflow Center
description: Design and operate business processes and approval workflows.
connections: Connect to IAM, IntelliDesk, My Business Center, IntelliStaff, Automation Center, Help Buddy, notifications, and IntelliSync. IntelliSync synchronizes approved workflow definitions and execution metadata. Workflow approvals remain authoritative in the workflow engine.

title: Notification Center
description: Central administration and delivery of platform notifications.
connections: Connect to employee directory, tenant records, messaging, email, push notifications, workflow, SOC, and audit. IntelliSync synchronizes approved notification templates, preferences, and delivery metadata. Do not duplicate sensitive notification content into unauthorized systems.

title: Command & Control Center
description: Executive-level operational coordination across the enterprise.
connections: Connect to NOC, SOC, War Room, My Business Center, IntelliDesk, AI Systems, notifications, and Global Reporting & Analytics. IntelliSync supplies authorized operational status and incident summaries. Command & Control does not directly override system ownership or security authorization.

title: Global Search
description: One authorized search interface across the enterprise platform.
connections: Connect to authorized search indexes across My Workspace, IntelliBase, IntelliDesk, business records, applications, and operations. IAM permissions must be checked before returning results and again before opening protected records. IntelliSync maintains approved search indexes and metadata. It must not make restricted content searchable to unauthorized users.

title: Calendar & Scheduling Center
description: Central calendar and scheduling management.
connections: Connect to Collaboration & Productivity, Help Buddy, IntelliStaff, My Workspace, notifications, and external calendar connectors. IntelliSync manages authorized calendar synchronization, event mapping, conflict detection, and update reconciliation.

title: War Room & Emergency Operations Center
description: Coordinated response to serious operational, security, infrastructure, and business emergencies.
connections: Connect to SOC, NOC, Command & Control Center, Help Buddy, AI Systems, IntelliDesk, calendar, notifications, workflow, and audit. IntelliSync transfers approved incident metadata, scenario definitions, assignments, and after-action reports. Simulated incidents must be clearly separated from live incidents. Simulation actions must not accidentally execute real production changes.

title: AI Model & Provider Management
description: Manage AI providers, model availability, configuration, governance, and usage.
connections: Connect to AI Systems, Configuration Center, secure secret storage, API gateway, IAM, billing, and audit. IntelliSync synchronizes approved model metadata, usage summaries, and configuration references. Provider credentials must remain in secure secret storage.

title: Global Reporting & Analytics
description: Enterprise-wide reporting, measurement, dashboards, and business intelligence.
connections: Connect to business databases, financial systems, IntelliStaff, NOC, SOC, IntelliDesk, Configuration Center, Data Management Center, and approved analytics stores. IntelliSync supplies approved data extracts and governed datasets. Reports must identify data freshness, source, reporting period, and incomplete or unavailable sources. title: Settings
description: Personal, account, platform, and authorized administrative preferences.
connections: Connect to IAM, My Workspace, Configuration Center, Connector Hub, billing, and audit.

title: Help Center
description: A populated, searchable user support destination.
connections: Connect to IntelliBase, IntelliDesk, SOC, Help Buddy, IAM, and notifications.
